scope: Read-only practical preflight of V10 scratch runner and worksheets; no owner/test or repo edits.

findings.detail: The actual 21 and main V7 source_inputs arrays each contain 148 rows (113 21.x, 35 main), not the worksheet claim of 150.
findings.fix: Confirm exact source input roster and count independently, then state actual count rather than asserting 150.
